about_the_game:
Dungeon Stars is a party-based dungeon crawler that blends RPG grinding with chaotic, satisfying randomization. Progress through procedurally generated dungeons, build your wealth, recruit powerful allies, and take on fearsome Rank Bosses in your quest for ultimate loot.

🌟 Key Features:

  • ⚔️ Party System Combat: Strategically assemble your team from randomized recruits, equip them with gear, and level them up to take on increasingly difficult enemies.

  • 🎲 Endless Randomization: Nearly everything in the game is procedurally generated — from enemies to weapons, gear, and even the dungeons themselves.

  • 🏆 Rank System Progression: Rise through the ranks from F to S by collecting Rank Scrolls and defeating 12 powerful Rank Bosses that guard each level of your journey.

  • 📈 Player Leveling & Stat Alignment: Gain XP from every activity and dungeon run. As you level up, unlock stronger recruits, better gear, and increase your influence over your team's growth through stat alignments.

🎮 Mini-Games & Activities:

  • 💎 Cave Sweeper: A mineral mining game inspired by Minesweeper with over 40 unique minerals to discover.

  • 🌾 Farming Sim: Grow a variety of crops, manage your plot, and turn your harvest into profit.

  • 🌲 Lumber Foraging: Collect and sell lumber with a dedicated store system.

  • 🎣 Fishing Sim: Upgrade your rod, hooks, and bait to catch higher rank fish — sell them or gut them for special loot.

📚 In-Game Library: Learn about items, enemies, and systems in the comprehensive in-game wiki.

🕒 Day/Night Cycle: Time passes based on your actions, not a real-time clock — giving you full control over how you play.

With over 120+ weapon and armor designs, infinite dungeon layouts, and a gear recycling/forging system, Dungeon Stars ensures that no two runs are ever the same. Build your team, conquer the ranks, and become a legend in the stars!
